test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Let A,B,C be the mid-points of sides XY, YZ and XZ, respectively of ΔXYZ. If the area of ΔXYZ is 8464 "cm²", then find the area (in "cm²") of ΔABC.
solution:
**Given:**

Area of △XYZ = 8464 cm²

A, B, and C be the mid-points of sides XY, YZ and XZ

**Concept used:**

The line segment in a triangle joining the midpoint of any two sides of the triangle

is said to be parallel to its third side and is also half of the length of the third side.

Heron's formula:

Area = √s(s - a)(s - b)(s - c)

Where, S = (a + b + c)/2

And a, b, c are the sides of the triangle. 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/adf734ab062530e999cfe8c4411cebc744602934e7dd3e4cdbcf7efb3bc83904.png] 

Semi-perimeter (S) = (XZ + X Y + YZ)/2

Area of △XYZ = √S(S - x)(S - y)(S - z)

⇒ √[(XZ + X Y + YZ)/2 × {(XZ + X Y + YZ)/2 - YZ} × {(XZ + X Y + YZ)/2 - XZ} × {(XZ + X Y + YZ)/2 - XY}]

⇒ √[(XZ + X Y + YZ)/2 × {(XZ + X Y + YZ)/ - 2YZ}/2 × {(XZ + X Y + YZ) - 2XZ}/2 × {(XZ + X Y + YZ) - 2XY}/2]

⇒ √[(XZ + X Y + YZ)/2 × (XZ + X Y + YZ)/2 × (XZ + X Y + YZ)/2 × (XZ + X Y + YZ)/2]

⇒ (XZ + X Y + YZ)²/4 = 8464 cm2 -------- (1)

With the midpoint theorem:

AC = YZ/2 ; AB = XZ/2 ; BC = XY/2

Semi-perimeter (S) = (AB + BC + AC)/2

⇒ {(XZ/2) + (XY/2) + (YZ/2)}/2

⇒ (XZ + X Y + YZ)/4

Area of △ABC = √S(S - a)(S - b)(S - c)

⇒ √[(XZ + X Y + YZ)/4 × {(XZ + X Y + YZ)/4 - XY/2} × {(XZ + X Y + YZ)/4 - YZ/2} × {(XZ + X Y + YZ)/4 - XZ/2}]

⇒ √[(XZ + X Y + YZ)/4 × {(XZ + X Y + YZ) - 2XY}/4 × {(XZ + X Y + YZ) - 2YZ}/4 × {(XZ + X Y + YZ) - 2XZ}/4]

⇒ √[(XZ + X Y + YZ)/4 × (XZ + X Y + YZ)/4 × (XZ + X Y + YZ)/4 × (XZ + X Y + YZ)/4]

⇒ (XZ + X Y + YZ)²/(4 ×4)

⇒ 8464/4 = 2116 cm² ------ From (1)

∴ The correct answer is 2116 cm2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

**Concept used:**

Area of △ABC = (1/4) × Area of △XYZ

**Calculation:**

Area of △ABC = (1/4) × Area of △XYZ

⇒ 8464/4 = 2116 cm2

**∴ The correct answer is 2116 cm².**
